text:
julia: Heads-up from pagers ap-south-1 GPU pool failed joins starting 03:18 UTC. Logs show KEYSERV decrypt retries and audit-forwarder 5xx/403 to siem-eu.redwood-sec.net after outbound ACL change at ~03:15. Anyone touching egress?
omar: I merged infra-fw#623 at 03:12 to narrow outbound ranges to reduce scope. Didn’t realize audit-forwarder uses a DNS-backed loadbalancer.
tess: When audit-forwarder hits 5xx it switches to buffered S3 ingestion which saturated the NAT instance and conntrack on the gateway. kube-probe -> crashloop/backoff on warm nodes.
ravi: Rolling back the ACL now, will push a revert. We should consider PrivateLink or pinned egress IPs for SIEM.
deploy-bot: FW-revert-623 applied by ravi at 03:26 UTC (CI: fw-revert-623).
omar: After revert, canary probe from audit-forwarder shows 200. KEYSERV decrypt errors cleared and GPU join rate recovering.
julia: Cost estimate: S3 fallback ~900GB egress @ $0.09/GB ~ $81. Opened FIN-830 and attached billing export.
tess: Action items: 1) ravi update firewall runbook to include audit-forwarder FQDN allowlist + test procedure, 2) omar prototype egress PrivateLink for SIEM, 3) julia include FIN-830 in incident doc and start postmortem template.
omar: I'll also add an alert: audit-forwarder 4xx/5xx > 1% for 2m -> paging.
julia: Good. Monitoring 1hr then closing. Ping me for any lingering join errors. :white_check_mark:
